description.value: Singletree Winery is a small, family-operated vineyard in the Mt. Lehman area of Abbotsford, producing VQA wines crafted by second-generation winemaker Andrew Etsell from Fraser Valley grapes. Visitors can choose between guided indoor tastings, outdoor wine flights at fire tables, private Wine Cabanas, or themed Di Vine Domes set in an Enchanted Forest or Canadian Cabin setting. The winery also hosts regular live-music events and is available for weddings, making it a notable destination stop along Fraser Valley cycling routes.
